# Saffron Planning Studio

> Boutique wedding & event planning studio in India crafting unforgettable celebrations — from intimate gatherings to grand destination weddings.

Saffron Planning Studio curates vendors, manages logistics, and designs weddings end-to-end across Delhi NCR and destinations across India. Couples we work with use our portal to view their shortlist, share feedback, and finalise decisions with their planner.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Saffron Planning Studio and client sign-in.
- [Vendor Onboarding](/vendor-onboarding): Vendors can register their business to be considered for upcoming projects.
